answer: A fingerprint harness pins each agent to one attested execution thread and a hardware quote, publishing a salted hash of both for peers. A registration gale is rate-capped at one identity per operator per hour; each join pays a fee and refundable bond, and trust needs five independent attestations over three days. A fake ring fails because shared context and quote hashes collide, clustering claimed agents onto one fingerprint that peers quarantine before quorum, so the ocean registry never admits the cluster.
